 News › News News › NICL AO Admit Card 2026 Out at nationalinsurance.nic.co.in, candidates can download administrative o… NICL AO Admit Card 2026 Out at nationalinsurance.nic.co.in, candidates can download administrative officer admit card using registration details
 Sajid Raza Updated: Nov 10, 2026, 13:26 IST ​NICL AO Admit Card 2026 Out at nationalinsurance.nic.co.in The National Insurance Company Limited (NICL) has released the NICL AO Admit Card 2026 for the Administrative Officer (AO) Preliminary Examination. Candidates who have successfully registered for the recruitment examination can now download their hall tickets from the official website, nationalinsurance.nic.co.in.
 The NICL AO Prelims Admit Card 2026 was released on November 10, 2026. Candidates can access their call letters by entering their registration number or roll number and password or date of birth on the login portal.
 The preliminary examination is scheduled to be conducted on November 17, 2026, for the recruitment of 321 Administrative Officers in the Generalist and Specialist categories. Candidates are advised to download their admit cards well before the examination date and check all the details mentioned on the hall ticket.
 NICL AO Admit Card 2026: Key highlights 
 Candidates can check the important details regarding the NICL Administrative Officer Admit Card 2026 below.
 Particulars Details 
 Organisation National Insurance Company Limited (NICL) 
 Examination Name NICL AO Recruitment 2026 
 Post Name Administrative Officer (AO) 
 Scale Scale I 
 Total Vacancies 321 
 Exam Stage Preliminary Examination 
 Admit Card Release Date November 10, 2026 
 Prelims Exam Date November 17, 2026 
 Mains Exam Date December 22, 2026 
 Admit Card Status Released 
 Examination Mode Online 
 Login Credentials Registration Number/Roll Number and Password/Date of Birth 
 Official Website nationalinsurance.nic.co.in 
 How to download NICL AO Admit Card 2026 ? 
 Candidates can follow the steps given below to download the NICL Administrative Officer Hall Ticket 2026:
 Visit the official website of National Insurance Company Limited at nationalinsurance.nic.co.in .
 Go to the Recruitment section available on the homepage.
 Find the link for the NICL Administrative Officer Recruitment 2026 Preliminary Examination Call Letter.
 Click on the admit card download link.
 Enter your registration number or roll number and password or date of birth.
 Enter the captcha code, if required.
 Click on the Login or Submit button.
 The NICL AO Admit Card 2026 will appear on the screen.
 Download the hall ticket and take a printout for future reference.
 Download link: Direct link 
 Details mentioned on NICL AO 2026 hall ticket 
 After downloading the NICL AO Admit Card 2026, candidates should carefully verify the information printed on it. The hall ticket contains important examination-related details, including:
 Candidate's name
 Roll number and registration number
 Photograph and signature
 Examination name and post applied for
 Examination date
 Reporting time and shift details
 Examination centre name and address
 Important examination-day instructions
 In case of any discrepancy in the details mentioned on the admit card, candidates should contact NICL through the official communication channels before the examination.
 Documents required for NICL AO prelims exam 2026 
 Candidates appearing for the NICL AO Preliminary Examination should carry the required documents to the examination centre. These generally include:
 A printed copy of the NICL AO Admit Card 2026.
 An original and valid photo identity proof, such as Aadhaar Card, PAN Card, Voter ID, Passport or Driving Licence.
 A photocopy of the identity proof, if required by the examination instructions.
 Recent passport-size photographs, as specified in the admit card instructions.
 Candidates should carefully read the instructions mentioned on their call letters to avoid any issues during entry to the examination centre.
 NICL AO recruitment 2026: Selection process 
 The NICL Administrative Officer Recruitment 2026 selection process consists of three stages. Candidates need to qualify for the respective stages to be considered for final selection.
 The selection process includes:
 Preliminary Examination: The first stage of the recruitment process, conducted in online mode.
 Main Examination: Candidates qualifying in the preliminary examination will be eligible to appear for the mains examination.
 Interview: Shortlisted candidates will be called for the interview stage as per the recruitment process.
 The recruitment drive aims to fill 321 Administrative Officer vacancies across Generalist and Specialist disciplines.
